note: Three initial read-only terminal bootstrap probes preceded the spawnSync receipt runner. Their exact terminal requests and returned output/exit codes are recorded in bootstrap receipts; terminal did not expose start timestamps or durations, so those fields are null rather than invented. Subsequent child commands have measured timestamps/durations and bounded logs. Terminal driver invocations launch the recorded .mjs orchestration.
